annotations.title: Read a table's rows from an extraction job's datasheet

description: One parsed table's printed rows in print order (row_index 0 = top row; two rows with the same values stay two rows), each with its line text as printed, its cells (cell_id, text, box, row_span, col_span) and the cells spanning down into it (covered_by). A spanning cell is listed once, in its first row. Also the table's caption and its continuation onto other pages. Paged (row_offset / next_row_offset, at most 500 rows). Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.

block_id.description: A block id from another of these tools (e.g. 'p36-b4-1a2b3c'); stable within one parser_version.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).

row_limit.description: Rows to return. Default 100, at most 500.

row_offset.description: Skip this many rows (from next_offset). Default 0.
